simple.summary: פַּרְסִי (Parçîy) means Persian. First listed occurrence: Dan 6 29.

definitions.full: H6543. Parsay [ מַּרְסַי ] adjective, of a people Persian ; — emphatic פרסיא Kt, מְּרְסָאָה Qr (K § 61, 6 ) Daniel 6:29 the Persian .
